ResourceARN.description: Returns the snapshot's Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

VolumeId.description: The ID of the volume that the snapshot is of.

Tags.description: A list of Tag values, with a maximum of 50 elements.

SnapshotType.description: The type of the snapshot: ONTAP for an FSx for NetApp ONTAP volume snapshot, OPENZFS for an FSx for OpenZFS volume snapshot.

OntapConfiguration.description: The configuration of an FSx for NetApp ONTAP snapshot. Only for snapshots of ONTAP volumes.

SnapmirrorLabel.description: The SnapMirror label of the snapshot. SnapMirror policies use the label to select which snapshots a relationship transfers and retains. After it is set, it can be changed but not removed; removing it from the template leaves the current value.

ExpiryTime.description: The ONTAP expiry time of the snapshot. The snapshot can't be deleted before this time. After it is set, it can be changed but not removed; removing it from the template leaves the current value.

SnaplockExpiryTime.description: The time until which the snapshot is locked against deletion. Only for volumes with ONTAP snapshot locking enabled. After it is set, it can be changed but not removed; removing it from the template leaves the current value.

UUID.description: The ONTAP UUID of the snapshot. Present once the snapshot exists on the file system.

Key.description: A value that specifies the TagKey, the name of the tag. Tag keys must be unique for the resource to which they are attached.

Value.description: A value that specifies the TagValue, the value assigned to the corresponding tag key. Tag values can be null and don't have to be unique in a tag set. For example, you can have a key-value pair in a tag set of finances : April and also of payroll : April.
